verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own docs show tasks can be kicked off by mentioning @Claude in Slack and getting a pull request back, and by tagging @claude on GitHub. GitLab is covered through GitLab CI/CD automation for code review and issue triage, but nothing shows an interactive in-GitLab trigger, and Linear is never mentioned. missing for 10: any Linear integration for kicking off tasks, a documented interactive GitLab trigger (beyond CI pipelines), and independent hands-on corroboration of the Slack and GitHub triggers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: mention @Claude in Slack with a bug report and get a pull request back
In CI, you can automate code review and issue triage with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD.
